blocks.text: A machine accepting power only proves its energy interface works. The chip still has to match a recipe in that machine’s input slots.

rows: Read the item name: Dirty circuit, Damaged circuit or Circuit Board.
Use Restoration for Dirty; Reassembly for Damaged; Processing handles both. Analysis expects a clean, not already analysed board.
Put the chip in a process input, not the Power slot, an output or an upgrade slot.
Open the matching machine recipe in this guide and verify that the server still provides it.
Compare stored energy with the effective batch cost and leave output space. The progress duration can be changed in the server configuration.
After one successful batch, test automation separately so a Disabled/Input-only output face does not hide the successful conversion.
